descriptionHtml:
Feature: Location search by full or partial name

As a traveller typing a destination into a search box, I want matching cities and towns suggested as I type so that I can pick the exact place I mean before seeing activity rankings.

The front end calls this endpoint on every keystroke (autocomplete), so answers must be fast and predictable, and "nothing found" must never be treated as an error.

Rule: The query and the number of suggestions are validated at their boundaries
